answers.note: Their first profile setup should be a guided wizard to provide all helpful context. Then, follow-up edits can feel more like account settings for quick direct edits.

However, drawing ideas from option 2, maybe there's a clean way to allow users to make a one-time selection (maybe within the profile setup wizard) to select and show all/hide all initially, then direct handling of events under profile from there.

This design should be simplified into a more '2 private events' tone. Doesn't need to do a ton of explaining, similar to option 1. However, it helps differentiate an active private user from a no-events private user with no public events.
